instructions_to_main_agent: Build a hybrid fullstack application (marketing pages + dashboard)
Implement the landing page with Hero, Courses Overview, AI Instructors, Pricing, and a clear call to action.
Implement the learning dashboard for authenticated users to view courses, levels, and XP/tokens.
Use 'Outfit' for all headings and 'IBM Plex Sans' for body text. Load them from Google Fonts.
Follow the specified dark theme with deep plum (#09050A base) and electric neon pink (#E6005C) accents.
Ensure the hero section uses the hero_background image with a dark gradient overlay (e.g., bg-black/60) to maintain text readability.
Instructors (Marcus, Nyx, Aria) should be showcased in a bento grid or stylized card layout using the provided instructor images.
Course thumbnails should use the connection and intimacy images.
Use Lucide React or Radix UI icons for UI elements.
Use generic shadcn components where needed (e.g., for forms, tabs in dashboard), but style them according to the color tokens.
Ensure all interactive elements have data-testid attributes for testing.
